'''"Quick-Shot" Quarl''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] member of the [[Coronas]] criminal gang, active in the [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3639 BBY]] he was killed in the [[Black Hole (Corellia)|Black Hole]] region of the [[Labor Valley]] by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Quick-Shot Quarl appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an NPC in the Black Hole. Killing him is required for a Republic-side daily quest.
